blocks.text: Mercaptans natural gas ko boo dene ke liye shamil kiye jate hain. Kuch thiols bohat dilute hone par khushgawar boo rakhte hain: thioterpineol grapefruit ki khushboo ka bunyadi juz hai, aur cis-glabanum oxathiane khushboodar compound hai jo umda fragrances, sabun, shampoo aur shower gels mein istemal hota hai. Bohat se qudrati odorants synthetic taur par banaye jate aur flavouring agents ke taur par bhi istemal hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Natural gas, jo khud be-boo hai, mein mercaptans kyun shamil kiye jate hain?
blocks.explanation: Methane ki koi boo nahi, to leak ka pata na chale; teez boo wale thiol ki halki si miqdar logon ko naak se leak ka pata lagane deti hai, gas ke khatarnak concentration tak pohnchne se bohat pehle.

items: Mercaptans natural gas ko boo dete hain; thioterpineol grapefruit ki khushboo; oxathiane umda fragrances mein; bohat se odorants synthetic bante aur flavouring mein istemal.
